environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no additional middleware or response header injection. The service listens directly on port 8080, traffic is forwarded as-is from NLB TCP listener. No reverse proxy, no CDN, no additional response header manipulation layer.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener on port 443 forwarding to target group port 8080
config.tls_termination: NLB TLS listener with ACM certificate
